// Find attempts to stop processes using net stop
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop"
| summarize netStopCount = dcount(ProcessCommandLine), NetStopList =
